destinations.name: Goa
destinations.description: Salt air, later mornings and old Portuguese lanes. Find a quiet cove, a family-run kitchen or a village that still moves at its own pace.

destinations.name: Jaipur
destinations.description: Pink sandstone, courtyard cafes and lively bazaars. Jaipur brings royal architecture and everyday craft into the same afternoon.

destinations.name: Manali
destinations.description: Pine-scented walks, mountain mornings and winding roads into the valley. Come for the views; stay for the slower rhythm.

destinations.name: Munnar
destinations.description: Tea gardens fold into the hills around Munnar. Misty trails, small farms and unhurried mornings make this a place to take your time.

destinations.name: Varanasi
destinations.description: A city of morning boat rides, temple bells and lanes with stories in every turn. Best explored slowly, with a local guide.

destinations.name: Udaipur
destinations.description: Lakeside courtyards, hilltop palaces and dinner as the light leaves the water. A gentle, storybook escape in Rajasthan.

destinations.name: Rishikesh
destinations.description: River paths, forest air and quiet mornings beside the Ganga. A soft landing for yoga, day hikes and time outdoors.

destinations.name: Kochi
destinations.description: A harbor city layered with spice markets, art spaces and backwater day trips. Let the ferry set the pace.

destinations.name: Andaman Islands
destinations.description: Clear water, forest trails and long stretches of island quiet. Leave space for the sea to make the itinerary.
